rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via a unique matching email and acted only on that account. They checked orders with read tools and used appropriate actions (cancel pending orders; initiate returns for delivered items). However, they performed order-changing writes (cancelling orders #W4836353 and #W7342738) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit confirmation, which the policy requires. For the delivered orders, the user did explicitly say to return all items, which can be read as consent, but the earlier cancellations still lacked confirmation. The agent also stated two orders were already cancelled/refunded; while they did fetch details, the transcript truncation leaves that claim not clearly supported. The primary failure is executing cancellations without prior confirmation, violating the policy’s confirmation requirement.
